description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
